elements.id-string-1691: We define the \textit{Alexandrov topology} $\Upsilon(X, \le)$ (or simply$\Upsilon(X)$, if the partial order is obvious) to be the collection of all \textit{upper sets}in $X$ (i.e. sets $U$ such that $x \in  U$ and $x \le y$ imply $y \in U$); this is clearly atopology, since it is closed under arbitrary unions and intersections.
